The upstream file here is unchanged. The study in ../../max removes the disconnected duplicate RNBO object, machine-specific export/snapshot references and demo-playlist entries, and adds three candidate parameter presets and attribution. The connected RNBO DSP boxes and connections are unchanged. No third-party audio recordings are bundled. This is an effect, not a complete shoegaze instrument.

Status: JSON/patchline structure checked only. Not opened/compiled/auditioned in Max; no Web Export produced. Presets are provisional, not acoustically validated. Preserve GPL notices and provide corresponding adapted source when distributing covered software; RNBO-generated output has its own export terms.
